topFindings.note: Non-production runs 24/7 (OP-06 = Crawl) on 25-49% of compute
Quantified at zero: coverage (50-74%) already meets the steady share once unscheduled non-production is removed. Action: do not buy further commitments until scheduling lands; re-baseline then

reasoning: Tier 2 (4 points) so most targets are Walk; Unit Economics target Crawl.
MP-01 = Run puts Practice Operations above target: the agency has the mandate the case describes.

Usage Optimization: core OP-04 Crawl; idle and scheduling depth answers also Crawl, so Crawl against a Walk target. The value uplift makes it High because the scheduling lever's expected net value is about 8% of spend.

LEV-01 is zero in every case: with coverage at 50-74% and up to half of compute in unscheduled non-production, the uncovered steady-state base is nil. This is the intended conservative behaviour, and the advice ('schedule first, then re-baseline commitments') is the useful output.
Upper case (25.5% of spend) comes from the band corner with 74% compute and 49% non-production; it stays under the 29% cap. Confidence Low because every share is a band.

Need index 36.7: base 16.7 (4 one-level gaps over 8 capabilities) + Tier 2 (10) + expected value at least 5% of spend (10). Band 'Establish foundations now' reads oddly for an agency with a FinOps programme (Q14).
scenarios.plausibilityCheck: The case reports strong Azure growth and a commitment portfolio; a model that finds little further commitment value but material scheduling value is consistent with an estate that has bought reservations before optimising usage. No outcome figure from the case is used.

Need index: mean gap 8 of 24 levels = 33.3; Tier 3 +20; expected public cloud value 8.5% of P >= 5% +10; growth 10% and no AI scope add nothing: 63.3, "Material exposure: act this year".

LEV-01 only: steady share 75-100% against coverage 25-49% with little unscheduled non-production. OCI spend counts in P (and so in the cap) but gets no LEV-01 value: no published OCI maximum is registered.

LEV-04 is not quantified although OP-06 is answered: with Kubernetes in scope, LEV-04 needs the cluster spend (DESIGN 10.15, "no base, no number"), which only VB-06 in the workshop asks. A scope-confirmation finding (Medium, LEV-04 material) asks for it.

Band corners: the upper corner (all spend and shares at their favourable ends) gives BRL 36.4M, capped at 29% of BRL 105M = BRL 30.45M. The conservative corner is unique (steady 75% minus coverage 49% minus unscheduled non-production 12.5% still leaves 13.5%): BRL 0.66M.
scenarios.plausibilityCheck: The spread from conservative (1.0% of P) to capped upper (29%) is the widest in the set and comes from seven banded executive inputs; the expected case (8.5% of P) is the figure a CFO should read. Under the Flexera 2026 29% self-estimate ceiling by construction.
